name: Jánossomorja (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of yellow triangles along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the town arms of Jánossomorja: a blue shield with two white swans, white flowers and a red flower on a green base.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
